units.learning_goal: 区分 KEYDOWN 边沿与 pygame.key.get_pressed 的持续状态。

units.name: 真实时间计时与限帧
units.project_task: 记录起点 ticks，显示本轮秒数，并在 R 时重置起点。
units.learning_goal: 理解真实时钟差值与帧计数的区别。
units.practice_check: 胜利界面秒数与实际游玩时间大致相符，改变帧率不影响读数。
units.acceptable_partial_support: pygame get_ticks时间差、clock.tick限帧和重置基准可分别部分支持，二者不能互相代替。

decision_labels.relevant_partial_candidate: Correct tool plus an actual observed project operation. Keep unsupported concepts and business rules unknown; not a complete learning-unit pass.
decision_labels.source_backed_specific_skill: Own verified video content/description/catalog explicitly establishes the specific confirmed skill, bound to its evidence ID and current target text. Still not execution/playback proof.
decision_labels.needs_review: A relevant lead with uncertain identity/content/stage or an example whose scope must be checked; does not count as supported teaching.
decision_labels.reject_direct_recommendation: Generic intro instead of the project operation, incompatible library/method, evidence borrowed from related videos, contradictory behavior or access/identity uncertainty.
decision_labels.no_result: No suitable displayed candidate; truthful empty state, not a relevance pass.

global_rules: Real video/course identity and safe platform URL must be tied to own page evidence; no new playback verification is required or claimed.
Paywall/login/region restrictions are access conditions, not proof of a nonexistent or invalid link.
Titles and one-part duplicate titles can establish a narrow topic lead, not specific API parameters, boundary behavior, depth or complete teaching.
Search snippets, related-video lists, ads, author bios, navigation, adjacent pages, TODO, prerequisites and cumulative unrelated code cannot supply skill or learner-stage evidence.
Generalize dataset/example names only when the actual operation/tool remains supported; a course need not use bicycles, a maze or a Pomodoro.
Every confirmed concept must remain visible as unknown until its own source evidence exists; operation_core support must not fill learning_target rows.
A beginner library lesson may fit the advanced bicycle learner new to pandas/Matplotlib; generic Python basics are not an adequate substitute.
Learner level and spoken language stay unknown unless owned source evidence establishes them; page language or nearby related-video words are insufficient.
Do not infer pandas pd aliases, parameters, numeric comparisons, inclusive ranges or cross-library equivalence solely from a model or a framework name.
Source claims of demo/self-study/prerequisite/negation must retain scope. They may be optional examples, not silently promoted into complete instruction.
One relevant partial card can help a student without passing the unit; full collection metrics and human instructional relevance are separate.
No source is seeded to improve results, no call or request budget is increased, and the staged semantic prototype is excluded from this run.
review_dimensions: Actual confirmed skill and boundary scope
Actionable next step without false completion

completion_criteria.unit_relevance_review: Manually review all displayed candidate bodies/catalog evidence per selected unit; separate no-result and unknown from rejected irrelevant candidates.
completion_criteria.coverage_claim: Do not equate one partial candidate, URL presence, or generic library familiarity with complete unit teaching.
completion_criteria.terminal_evidence_required: Wait for saved final results of all four cases; initial running metrics are provisional snapshots.
